description: The plot illustrates the training loss over steps for six different model variants—ChemBART Small 20M, ChemBART Medium 20M, ChemBERTa Small 20M, ChemBERTa Medium 20M, ChemLLaMA Small 20M, and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M—each trained on 20 million data points. The x-axis, labeled “Step,” spans from 0 to approximately 440K steps, with major tick marks at intervals of 20K (e.g., 0K, 20K, 40K, ..., 440K), and uses a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “Train Loss,” ranges from 0.0 to 0.85, with major gridlines at 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.75, and 0.85, also on a linear scale. All six lines begin near a loss of 0.85 at step 0 and exhibit a steep initial decline, converging toward a loss of approximately 0.2–0.3 by 20K steps. Beyond 20K steps, the loss continues to decrease gradually, with all lines stabilizing between 0.2 and 0.3 by 80K steps. From 80K to 440K steps, the lines remain relatively flat with minor fluctuations, indicating convergence. The ChemLLaMA Medium 20M (brown) and ChemLLaMA Small 20M (purple) lines consistently show slightly lower loss values than the others in the later stages, while ChemBART Small 20M (red) and ChemBERTa Medium 20M (green) remain slightly higher. The inset zooms in on the 420K–440K step range, showing that all models have stabilized with minimal variation in loss.
